## Batch 8 completed

Authored all seven assigned items, the A/B page frontmatter, manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, notes, cross-batch inputs, and seven hash-closed `ready` Step 1 records. All seven item dependency labels match recomputation; batch 8 remains level 2 with prerequisites 2 and 7.

## Remaining workflow blockers

The live autopilot still shows batch 8 among uncovered dispatch units. Its `1-scaffold` stage is held by the separate batch-58 blocker; I left engine state and verdicts untouched. A whole-run dependency-ledger aggregation also stopped on an existing batch-15 ownership error, while the scoped check of batch 8’s five cross-batch rows passed.

The source review found that polynomial singular-value decay is termed *moderately* ill-posed in Ding–Mathé’s operator taxonomy, so the example avoids conflating that with statistical “mild” rates. [Ding–Mathé](https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.01706) The identifiable Clason Chapter 12 source concerns parabolic finite-element methods, not statistical risk; it is marked out of scope in the coverage record. [Clason notes](https://arxiv.org/abs/1709.08618) The other full-text treatments support the authored claims.

The `ready` records document author readiness; they are not independent approval or publication.
